The Chilean woman is soft spoken, shy, and never confronts anyone, even when the other person is clearly in the wrong. The Korean woman, on the other hand, speaks her mind pretty freely. She's not aggressive, but people definitely know where they stand with her. Who is very docile?
A. Undetermined
B. The Chilean woman
C. The Korean woman
